title: Taxpayer portal on the Vati Workspace shell with an evidence-request inbox
scope: Rebuild the re-centred portal (TAX-125) as an inbox: evidence requests listed like messages grouped by due date with a reading pane, responses as short steps with the TAX-126 checks, My cases with RSL's status labelled as RSL's, and account; remove starter copy, hero titles and card-grid layouts

acceptance.text: Evidence requests use a list-detail layout on desktop and list-then-detail on 390px; each response step fits one viewport and keeps entered values on error
Taxpayers never see officer navigation, risk signals or component names; the portal footer links the open-source notices
Live Frappe login is used where available; fixture mode is labelled in the header strip

Screenshots at 1440, 1024 and 390px with loading, empty, error and denied states, keyboard/focus and axe results, and the TAX-144 page-length result; record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Updated taxpayer unit and Playwright tests against the Frappe dev site

evidence.text: Evidence requests are an inbox grouped by reply-by date (src/lib/inbox.ts, inbox.test.ts) beside a reading pane on desktop (/taxpayer/requests/:id), list then detail below 1024px with a link back. The response is steps: one per requested item, then Review and send; each step fits one viewport at 1440/1024/390 and every step stays mounted, so values are kept between steps and on error (sending opens the first unanswered item, focus on its heading); inbox.spec.ts and responses.spec.ts (24) pass.

No officer navigation, risk wording or component names on any portal screen (inbox.spec.ts checks, TAX-150 naming checks: 0 names); the portal footer links the open-source notices; no starter copy, hero titles or card grids remain.
The portal uses the live Frappe login (the /taxpayer page guard, TAX-029); fixture mode shows only as the 'Synthetic data' strip in the header (inbox.spec.ts).

docs/evidence/TAX-152: 30 screenshots at 1440/1024/390 (inbox, request, each step, error with values kept, loading/empty/error/denied); inbox.spec.ts 9 passed with axe, keyboard focus and the page-length budget (inbox and request 1.00 viewports); npm run check and dev.py check pass; full frontend suite 335 passed with only the 9 demo-harness failures after the taxpayer journeys were moved to the steps.
